Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review because the change affects geometry checks.

The continuous bounds and projection tests cover the reported failures. The crafted records exercise all five planner refusals and both capped-within-tolerance notes. No golden files or UI files changed.

Tests ran locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-kernel --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only kernel` | Passed in 280 seconds |
| Kernel library | 3 passed |
| `machining_mesh` | 7 passed |
| `machining_mesh_bounds` | 4 passed |
| `machining_mesh_shortfalls` | 4 passed |
| `step_agreement` | 18 passed |
| `mesh_deviation_bench` | 1 ignored; release-only test |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I repeated two mutations locally:

- I removed the analytic bound from the exact-surface path. `between_sample_sag_past_tolerance_is_refused` failed with `0.004909330499735631`. The test passed after restoration.
- I set the parametric remainder to zero in `tri_metrics`. `between_sample_spline_sag_past_tolerance_is_refused` failed with `1.1443916996305594e-16`. The test passed after restoration.

The source was restored without a remaining change.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/kernel/tests/machining_mesh_shortfalls.rs:206`: Reduce the runtime of `provoke_face_capped_note`, or move it to the release heavy lane. The new test is active in the default debug suite. The local run reported:

   ```text
   test provoke_face_capped_note has been running for over 60 seconds
   ```

   The shortfalls suite passed in 121.84 seconds. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under Testing, requires a smaller fixture or the heavy lane for debug tests above about 60 seconds. Keep the capped-note assertion. If you move the test, add an ignore reason that names the lane and verify it in release mode.

The full workspace and the release-only deviation bench were not run. No geometry correctness defect was found in this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The slow `provoke_face_capped_note` test now runs in the release heavy lane. Its ignore reason names the lane. The fixture and capped-note assertion are unchanged.

The ignored-test membership check went RED when the ignore attribute was removed and GREEN after restoration. The existing capped-note assertion went RED when the emitted note was mutated and GREEN after restoration. The release test passed in 10.56 seconds.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed in 74 seconds. The shortfalls suite passed in 1.09 seconds with 3 passed and 1 ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: `7efea82464d78c31a5d7d63754744c8e25ba5997`.

Please re-review.
